_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — lti-tool-lockdown (ocon#147 phase C). SECURITY FIX. The `lti_tool` schema had NO `authorization` block, so it fell back to OpenRegister's default: readable by ANY authenticated user. An LTI Tool registration is admin-owned trust config — its `clientId`, `oidcLoginUrl`, `launchUrl` and `jwksUri` define which external tool this instance launches into and trusts — and it carries the (now writeOnly) private signing keys. Every verb is admin-only, mirroring source/consumer/lti_platform: operators provision tools under Beheer > Authenticatie and the launch runtime consumes them. Nothing regresses: LtiRegistrationResolverService / LtiKeyService / LtiLaunchService read every tool registration with _rbac: false, so launch and JWKS publish keep working for anonymous and non-admin callers.
